title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.85
summary: Automatische HTTPS-Cloud-Registrierung mit persistenter Server-ID ohne Kopplungscode.
changes: Automatically register the persistent UUID and device secret on backend startup without pairing
Remove pairing-code requirement from local admin API and frontend
Keep device secrets encrypted locally, preserve IDs and honor portal revocation
Use the existing outbound HTTPS relay, central HLS and camera-authenticated login
Deploy the matching private Plesk/MySQL portal V3 separately; PHP is not in this repository
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.85
description: Automatic outbound-only camera cloud registration with pinned device identity and ID-based portal login.
releaseNotes: No one-time pairing code: camera installation auto-registers its persistent UUID with a unique encrypted device key. Portal users enter installation ID and their normal camera credentials. Private PHP/MySQL portal is deployed separately, not in Git.
